summary.text: Juan Porras represents District 119, part of Miami-Dade County, in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Porras was first elected in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Porras is a small business owner who lives in Miami, where Porras was born.
Porras holds a bachelor's degree in political science from Florida International University.
